{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we keep the latest (and presumably most reliable) measurement
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_patients}")"}
